newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia securities trades off 6.1 pct in 1st half.
newsitem.headline: Colombia securities trades off 6.1 pct in 1st half.

text.p: Trading in all securities on Colombia's three stock markets fell 6.1 percent in the first half of 1997 to 18.6 trillion pesos, the Securities Superintendacy said Monday.

It said trading in private sector fixed-income instruments fell by 42.8 percent year over year to 3.8 trillion pesos. Lower interest rates generally soured investors on fixed-income paper, the superintendancy said.
By contrast, stock trades grew 46.3 percent to about 1.5 trillion pesos.
Volume on the Bogota, Medellin and Cali exchanges benefited from auctions of state-owned stakes in mining and gas distribution.

Treasury notes dominated trading in official paper. But government bonds suffered the biggest drop, falling to 3.4 percent of total trading in the first six months of 1997 from 6.1 percent in the first half of 1996.
